system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the eighth grade. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
These 3 questions belong together and follow one another in the test booklet.

## Question 1

Betty talks for less than 2 hours per month. Which plan would be less expensive for her?

Less expensive plan ____

Explain your answer in terms of both the monthly fee and free minutes.

## Question 2

Frank talks for 5 hours per month at the night rate. What would each plan cost him per month? Show your work.

Cost Per Month for Plan A: ____ zeds

Cost Per Month for Plan B: ____ zeds

## Question 3

Darlene signed up for the Plan B, and the cost of one month of service was 75 zeds. How many minutes did she talk that month? Show your work.

Minutes talked ____

Answer each of the 3 questions.

answer_1.description: Your answer to question 1, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer_1.title: Answer 1

answer_2.description: Your answer to question 2, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer_2.title: Answer 2

answer_3.description: Your answer to question 3, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer_3.title: Answer 3

output.answer_1: Assumed plan details, since the plan table is not included in the question text: Plan A has a monthly fee of 20 zeds and 100 free minutes, then 0.10 zeds per minute at the night rate. Plan B has a monthly fee of 35 zeds and 200 free minutes, then 0.03 zeds per minute at the night rate, and 0.20 zeds per minute at the day rate. Less expensive plan: Plan A. Explanation: Betty talks for less than 120 minutes, which is within Plan A's 100 free minutes plus a few paid minutes at most. Plan A's monthly fee of 20 zeds is lower than Plan B's 35 zeds, and Plan B's 200 free minutes are more than she needs, so Plan B's higher fee is not offset. Plan A therefore costs her 20 zeds, or slightly more if she goes past 100 minutes, while Plan B costs at least 35 zeds.
output.answer_2: Assumed plan details as in Question 1. Five hours is 300 minutes at the night rate. Plan A: 20 + (300 − 100) × 0.10 = 20 + 20 = 40 zeds. Plan B: 35 + (300 − 200) × 0.03 = 35 + 3 = 38 zeds. Cost Per Month for Plan A: 40 zeds. Cost Per Month for Plan B: 38 zeds.
output.answer_3: Assumed plan details as in Question 1. Plan B costs 35 zeds for the monthly fee plus 0.20 zeds per minute beyond the 200 free minutes at the day rate. 75 − 35 = 40 zeds of usage charges. 40 ÷ 0.20 = 200 paid minutes. 200 free minutes + 200 paid minutes = 400 minutes. Minutes talked: 400.
